name: Obzedat
description: The ghostly guildmasters of the Orzhov whom Teysa conspired to remove.

description_citations.text: "Teysa Karlov". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Uncle becomes a ghost, joins the Obzedat and watches Teysa through a mirror.
timeline.quote: He now is a ghost and has joined the Obzedat

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa discovers Melisk has been erasing her memory and that Uncle's death and the deal with Niv-Mizzet were Obzedat schemes; she breaks her oath.
timeline.quote: Teysa's memory is returned.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Dissension Teysa helps draft a new non-magical Guildpact and becomes the first Grand Envoy of the Orzhov.
timeline.quote: has been made the first and only Grand Envoy of the Orzhov Syndicate

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Grand envoy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa's coup with Tajic against the Obzedat is foiled by her ghostly grandfather, and the Ghost Council strips her of her offices.
timeline.quote: she was foiled by her ghostly grandfather and stripped of her office of advokist and grand envoy by the Ghost Council.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Staging a coup". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The angel delivers a message from the ghost halls of the Obzedat for Teysa Karlov.
timeline.quote: I have come from the ghost halls of the Obzedat with a message for Teysa Karlov.

citation.text: "Behind the Black Sun". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Tajic scouts with a platoon, linking with Orzhov patrols that, through Teysa Karlov, helped root out Dimir sleeper cells; the Obzedat agree to shared protection of the Ninth.
timeline.quote: the Boros and Orzhov would share protection duties over the Ninth

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Teysa returns from another day of being yelled at by the Orzhov Ghost Council and reads her old mail by the fire.
timeline.quote: Teysa Karlov had spent another full day being yelled at by the dead.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Teysa resolves to use a loophole created by the Guildpact's new body to challenge the Obzedat's monopoly.
timeline.quote: She could manipulate this technicality to challenge the monopoly of the Obzedat.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: They find the preserved, mummified bodies of the Obzedat on thrones, and Teysa greets her uncle's body.
timeline.quote: Hello, Uncle,

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Karlov reveals himself and summons the Obzedat, who rise from the floor.
timeline.quote: Tajic yelled with surprise as dozens of ghosts swiftly rose from beneath the floor.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: The Obzedat revoke Teysa's title of advokist and forbid her the practice of law.
timeline.quote: By order of the Obzedat, your title of advokist is hereby revoked .

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Kaya, sent by Bolas, infiltrates the catacombs and kills Grandfather Karlov and the Obzedat, becoming the new Orzhov leader; Teysa is reinstated as leading oligarch.
timeline.quote: Kaya infiltrated the catacombs and killed Grandfather Karlov and all other members of the Obzedat.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Awaiting her time". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa convenes a meeting of the Obzedat and Kaya ends it.
timeline.quote: Kaya ended it.

citation.text: Kaya's Wrath (Ravnica Allegiance Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaya ends a meeting of the Obzedat convened by Teysa.
timeline.quote: Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.

citation.text: Kaya's Wrath (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orzhov vampires look for allies in case their new guildmaster turns on them after the fate of the Obzedat.
timeline.quote: The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.

citation.text: Vizkopa Vampire (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas promises to heal Tolvada's sky in return for Kaya's help killing the Obzedat.
timeline.quote: he had promised her he would heal the sky in return for her assistance in killing the Obzedat on Ravnica

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Tolvada". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas hires Kaya to kill the Obzedat and become Orzhov guildmaster.
timeline.quote: Bolas hired her to kill the Obzedat and become guildmaster of Orzhov

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills the Ghost Council and becomes guildmaster through a loophole.
timeline.quote: she had become the new guildmaster of the Syndicate

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya takes control as Orzhov guildmaster after taking down the Obzedat, at Bolas's behest.
timeline.quote: Lately, the planeswalker Kaya has taken control as guildmaster of Orzhov after taking down the Obzedat.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Under the influence of Bolas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Miri gives her father the money she skimmed from tithes, and it is revealed the family fortune was lost with the Ghost Council.
timeline.quote: He'd returned home with the truth: there was no family fortune.

citation.text: "The Ledger of Hidden Fortunes" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya killed all members of the Council and took over as guildmaster, ending the Obzedat's reign.
timeline.quote: The reign of the Obzedat ended when the planeswalker Kaya killed all members of the Council and took over as guildmaster .

citation.text: "Obzedat", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa asked Tajic to help remove the Obzedat; the plot failed and the Orzhov imprisoned him until Aurelia freed him.
timeline.quote: Tajic was taken prisoner by the Orzhov

citation.text: "Tajic", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Teysa is bound to obey the Obzedat and kiss Karlov's ring.
relations.quote: You owe us your unquestioning service.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

relations.note: Karlov is a Councilman among the Obzedat ghosts.
relations.quote: The Grand Envoy of the Orzhov seeks to upend the council.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.

relations.note: Teysa seeks to challenge and escape the Obzedat.
relations.quote: She could manipulate this technicality to challenge the monopoly of the Obzedat.

citation.text: "Family Values" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2015.
Kaya's Wrath (Ravnica Allegiance Promos, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.
